name: youtube-watch-party
description: Watch YouTube together in real time — React + Node.js + Socket.IO (WebSockets) + MongoDB

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix frontend
